init_logging_default: init logging with default INFO level on the root logger using init_logging()
init_logging_custom_level: init logging at DEBUG level by calling init_logging with level=logging.DEBUG
init_logging_custom_logger: init logging on a specific logger instance by passing logger=logging.getLogger('my_module')
init_logging_error_level: init logging at ERROR level to only show error messages via init_logging(level=logging.ERROR)
init_logging_warning_level: init logging at WARNING level to suppress INFO messages using init_logging(level=logging.WARNING)
